# Where H, M and L land, measured 2026-09-04 against /opt/homebrew/bin/vim,
# VIM 9.2 patches 1-321, the same way as the scroll table beside this one.
#
#   keys  height  scrolloff  topline  cursor  ->  topline  cursor  scroll
#
# The three motions live in internal/motion, which may not import this package
# and is handed a window.Visible instead. This table is here rather than there
# because what it really tests is whether Visible carries enough: Top, Bottom
# and the two AtTop/AtBottom flags that suspend 'scrolloff' at the ends of the
# buffer. internal/window/visible_test.go replays it through the same rule
# internal/motion implements, so a Visible that starts reporting the wrong
# bottom line fails here as well as there.
